stem: What was one major impact of this novel?

options.label: A
options.text: The profits from book sales funded early labor organizations.

options.label: B
options.text: Congress was inspired to pass laws outlawing the abuse of slaves.

options.label: C
options.text: The Supreme Court overturned fugitive slave laws.

options.label: D
options.text: Support grew for the abolitionist movement.
